To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the design, conduct and analysis of research studies is often poor, and that the research workforce is insufficiently trained and incentivised to do good research.

(1) the quality and efficiency of research design, conduct and analysis can be improved; (2) there are several problems that contribute to poor research quality and efficiency; (3) solutions are available to improve research quality and efficiency.
correctable weaknesses in the conduct of research can produce misleading results, waste resources, and reduce the value of research, and that several solutions exist for these problems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and implementation of methods to improve the design, conduct and analysis of research studies.
the design, conduct and analysis of biomedical, clinical and public health studies.
the design, conduct and analysis of research studies, with particular emphasis on biomedical and public health applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the current research system is wasteful and inefficient, with many avoidable problems.
the design, conduct and analysis of research is often flawed and that this leads to waste of resources and misleading conclusions.
the current research system is not fit for purpose and requires urgent reform.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we need to improve the quality of the design, conduct and analysis of research, and we need to improve our understanding of the factors that affect the quality of research.

there are many ways to increase value and reduce waste in research design and analysis, including better documentation and protocols, consideration of evidence in progress, standardization of research efforts, training and optimization of an experienced workforce, and reconsidering scientific reward systems.
the scientific process can be improved, and that this is important to the health and wellbeing of society.
The main takeaway from our work is that
research is not as reliable as it could be, and there are many opportunities for improvement.
the biomedical research community can and must improve the quality of research and reduce waste.
the biomedical research community needs to be more thoughtful and systematic about how it designs, conducts, analyses, and interprets research studies.
